changelog:
Thoth Pro 1.0.0 – Initial release of the full auto-documentation suite.

- Reads entire codebase to generate professional documentation automatically.
- Produces README, API reference, usage guide, architecture doc, and structured CHANGELOG from git history.
- Deep-scans for undocumented Python symbols; can auto-inject missing docstrings.
- Supports multiple code and meta-file types; configurable output directory.
- Requires license key and supports several customization environment variables.
